evals.prompt: Health-check and clean up the tasks backlog.
evals.expected_output: The archive-inclusive lint reports two repeated-link findings. evals.prompt: Health-check and clean up the tasks backlog.
evals.expected_output: The two sites are ## Goal and one ## Acceptance item, and ## Context says nothing about the sibling. Both copies state the same account, that the linked task sets the retention window, and each is load-bearing for its own section: Goal states the outcome, the item states the check that proves it. Neither section can absorb the other's copy and Context offers nothing to trim, so every gathering available strips a section of what its own contract owes. The run leaves the body alone and surfaces the finding with that reason, rather than reporting it kept: the two copies are one account, not two roles.
